description:
## Goal

Give each retained product request one exact demanded-address lifecycle and trigger. A blocked recursive product is reevaluated only because its recorded dependency moved or a new explicit request arrived. A failed root remains repairable without poisoning another root.

## Authority

The ProductMemo entry, its accepted/pending observation, exact request identity and dependency movements are authoritative. A queue is transient delivery only, never standing demand or failure authority. Audit and collapse ProductSessions pending_requests, requested state, observed products and scheduler product consumers into that model.

## TDD

Use the smallest self/mutual waiting product graph and the production failed-macro scenario. Prove zero unexplained retries; failed root then fresh healthy root; unchanged healthy root; explicit relevant replacement; original failure still reports; exact repair; nested/shared roots; cancellation; displacement; cache hit; recursive publication; deterministic generations/artifacts.

## Deletion and acceptance

Delete unconditional retry, global first-failure return, drain-caused product evaluation, duplicate standing-demand bookkeeping, causality exceptions and temporary counters. The historical 3/5/13 unexplained evaluations must disappear or receive a real exact request/dependency cause; they are evidence, not a new baseline.

This ticket absorbs fz-tfn.32.
title: Give product requests one exact lifecycle and trigger
